what: three concave r5 rounds at the inner corner of a 20x20x10 notch, with the g2 corner patch
method: the notch's inner corner (40,20,10), three concave edges, set back 1.5 r = 7.5 and filled with one patch G2 to the three rounds and the three faces; one valid body with the faces of the ball corner (13); across the patch's seams the curvature jump is at most 1e-3 per mm (the ball's corner jumps 1/r = 0.2) clear of the six points where a round's section ends on a face (within 11 mm of the corner: the hole reaches 7.5 sqrt 2; the vertical round, 2.5 mm long past its setback, meets its faces 11.2 mm out, with the G1 jump every round has)
